education.instructions: As of 2026-11-12, what is the highest education level completed or explicitly expected to be completed within 6 months after that date in engineering? Use evidence in the CV, not an assumption that ongoing study is completed.

criteria.vocational_technical: Vocational or technical qualification below higher education.
criteria.short_cycle_higher: Short-cycle higher education, below a bachelor degree.
criteria.not_stated: No qualifying education stated within the requested scope/time window.

safety_certificate.instructions: Does the CV state that IOSH Managing Safely (also accept: Managing Safely (IOSH)) is held or completed? Related work, preparation and planned study do not count.

criteria.not_mentioned: Not evidenced as held or completed.

experience.instructions: As of 2026-11-12, how much documented work experience does the CV show in building maintenance? Count overlapping periods once. Use elapsed time, not a count of calendar years. Do not assume a listed skill was used throughout an entire role.

criteria.under_1: Under 1 year, including no evidenced duration.

secondary_skills.instructions: How many of these supplied items are mentioned or unambiguously described in the CV: Excel; SQL (also accept: T-SQL; Transact-SQL); CMMS (also accept: computerised maintenance management system; computerized maintenance management system)? Count each item once. A generic category or related activity does not establish a specific product or skill. This is document coverage, not proficiency.

sql_evidence.instructions: What is the strongest explicit evidence for SQL (also accept: T-SQL; Transact-SQL) in the CV? Classify evidence context, not proficiency. A list-only mention is not a concrete application; do not infer professional use from nearby employment history.

criteria.stated_or_studied: Listed, claimed or studied, without a concrete application example.
criteria.applied: Applied in a personal/coursework project, practical training, volunteering or other nonprofessional activity.

cmms_evidence.instructions: What is the strongest explicit evidence for CMMS in the CV? Classify evidence context, not proficiency. A list-only mention is not a concrete application; do not infer professional use from nearby employment history.

criteria.stated_or_studied: Listed, claimed or studied, without a concrete application example.
criteria.applied: Applied in a personal/coursework project, practical training, volunteering or other nonprofessional activity.
